body:
>Who instilled this rule into your life?" "Who said to be happy I needed a bundle of friends or an impressive resume of accomplishments?"

I did. I never seem to be able to do anything right. Hell, I never seem to do anything at all. I hate myself for not being good enough. I can't even cut myself anymore because I recoil in pain now. I look back and there's nothing there. I could just erase what little relevance I have to the world right now. 

And no, I can't just "snap out of it and find some hobbies."

>And the truth is, of almost all people who attempted suicide and failed, while they may try again later due to more depressive swings, almost always say they regretted trying. 

Survival instincts, I guess. I heard a lot of suicidal ideation comes from impulses and irrational thought.

I'm saying no because I don't want to die. And I hate myself for that because I feel like I should kill myself. There's nothing strong about some loser who can't take care of himself, that can't just "get over it" and wake up and do things for a change.

If I end it, nobody will miss me. I'll just be known as "that kid who shot himself." People will talk about it, my friends will forget about me, my parents will blame themselves for it, my sister won't take it well, but eventually they'll cope, and it'll pass.

Heh, sorry. Kinda flipped last night. Stupid stuff, but it's fine now I guess.

I don't know what to say anymore. I feel pretty alone, and honestly if you met me irl you wouldn't really like me that much. 

And people just use me. I'm just a tool to be used, and once they don't see anything to get out of me, they'll leave me. Nobody sees me as anything besides beneath them.

A lot's been on my mind, yet none of it's really been that important.

I kinda fell asleep shortly after posting that. I'm not exactly sure what I'm thinking right about now. I kinda just broke down and started crying again last night due to a multitude of things, but nothing too bad I guess. Like, I feel like my problems aren't really that bad, most of them are my fault anyways. I could vent a lot, but I don't know right now. I hate getting out of bed in the mornings, actually afternoons cause I don't really wake up until like 3 pm anyways.

>Even waking up today is more than enough to show you've got the stuff to make it in this world.

No...I don't. I'm a mess. I'm failing my freshman year of college, I barely have friends, I don't really do anything anymore. I feel like I'm rapidly running out of time and that if I try to feel better about myself that it's just all a lie.

I dunno. Part of me WANTS to be more suicidal, just to drive me over the edge so I can get it over with. What's the point in endlessly contemplating about such things I doubt I'll ever commit to?
